about.title: About Us
about.description:
AGH Analytica is a newly established student organization at AGH University of Science and Technology, bringing together enthusiasts of data analysis and cutting-edge technologies. 

 Our activities focus on innovative projects that allow members to develop their skills in satellite imagery and map analysis, stock market data analysis, image analysis and working with Large Language Models (LLMs).

gis.title: GIS
gis.text: We analyze geospatial datasets, GIS layers, and orthophotomaps - building intelligent systems that understand space.

stock.title: Stock market data
stock.text: We model financial markets and build investment algorithms powered by artificial intelligence.

llm.title: LLM & NLP
llm.text: We work with large language models - from interpreting text queries to building custom chatbots.

vision.title: Image analysis
vision.text: We apply computer vision for classification, detection, and segmentation - from satellite imagery to medical data.

developersChat.title: GeoAnalytica AI
developersChat.description:
An intelligent tool for finding the ideal plot for developers and private individuals. The system analyzes spatial data, including land development plans, satellite imagery, terrain features, sunlight exposure, and access to infrastructure and green areas. 

 The user describes their requirements, and AI automatically searches and organizes the best-matching locations. Each plot has a detailed profile and an assessment of its development potential.

tradeAnalysis.title: Analytica Invest
tradeAnalysis.description:
The project aims to develop an application that supports stock market investors by analyzing market data using advanced algorithms. 

 In later stages, the system will be enhanced with an artificial intelligence module capable of learning from historical and real-time data, ultimately generating its own investment recommendations and making autonomous trading decisions in simulated market environments.

roboDog.title: RoboDog Rescue AI
roboDog.description:
RoboDog is a new generation autonomous walking platform designed for work in extreme fire and disaster conditions. Using LiDAR and thermal imaging systems, the robot quickly locates injured individuals and maps dangerous areas, reaching places where human barriers prevent access. 

 Thanks to artificial intelligence, the device in real-time determines evacuation routes, guiding people to safety using voice commands and light signals. As a „first responder” support system, RoboDog minimizes the risk of rescuers by taking on the most difficult tasks where life or death depends on seconds.

emotionAI.title: Emotion AI
emotionAI.description:
A Computer Vision project: a system that analyses a camera feed, detects faces and recognises emotions using convolutional neural networks (CNNs).

We go all the way — from image processing in OpenCV, through building and training models in PyTorch, to a working solution. It is aimed at people who want to learn AI from the ground up and build a real portfolio project — with mentoring and proven materials.
